Markleaf is a local-first Markdown note app for Android.
Write plain Markdown, organize with inline tags, search instantly, and keep your notes under your control. Markleaf stores notes in a local Room database and does not declare the INTERNET permission.

Organizing and navigating:

Sync and import (No-Cloud):

* Single-note and all-notes Markdown export, plus system share
Design and accessibility:
* Home screen widget, biometric lock, screenshot blocking option

Privacy and distribution:

Features:
Plan & organize
* Calendar with appointments and an offline holiday layer
* Tasks to manage your to-dos
* Habits you can build and track
Capture & reflect
* Notes with markdown editor, a clean read view and a trash with restore
* Gratitude journal with a searchable archive
* Mood tracking over time
Wellbeing
* Meditation timer with three bells and Buddhist quotes
* Track caffeine intake and see how much caffeine is still active at bedtime
Money

* Detailed reports and savings potential

fdroid:com.nfcarchiver.nfc_archiver.name: NFC Archiver
fdroid:com.nfcarchiver.nfc_archiver.summary: Store and restore files across multiple NFC tags
fdroid:com.nfcarchiver.nfc_archiver.description:
A distributed data archive system using NFC tags. Store files across multiple NFC tags and restore them later.
Split any file into parts and write them to NFC tags. Scan the tags in any order to reassemble and restore the original file.
Features:
* File archiving — split any file into parts for writing to NFC tags
* Text archiving — store text messages across NFC tags
* Photo archiving — shrink a photo to fit the number of tags you choose; location and camera data are removed
* Share into the app — send a photo or file from Gallery, Photos or Files straight to NFC Archiver
* Restoration — scan tags in any order and assemble the original file
* Restored files — open them in another app, save them to Downloads or any folder, or share them
* Compression — optional GZIP compression to reduce the number of tags needed
* Encryption — AES-256-GCM encryption with password protection (PBKDF2 key derivation)
* Offline operation — no network connection required
* Chameleon Ultra — connect a Chameleon over Bluetooth and use it instead of the phone's NFC radio
* MIFARE Classic 1K — 752 usable bytes per card, with a Chameleon or a phone whose NFC chipset supports it
* Card inspector — dump a card block by block with a decoded NFAR header and CRC check (needs a Chameleon)
Supported NFC Tags:
* NTAG213 (144 bytes)
* NTAG215 (504 bytes)
* NTAG216 (888 bytes)
* MIFARE Ultralight C (144 bytes)
Uses the NFAR v1 binary format with a 28-byte header, CRC32 integrity checking, and UUID-based archive identification. Chunks can be scanned in any order and are validated automatically.
NFC Archiver is free and open source software. No tracking, no ads, no network access required.

fdroid:com.odnovolov.forgetmenot.name: ForgetMeNot
fdroid:com.odnovolov.forgetmenot.summary: A flashcard app that won't let you forget anything.
fdroid:com.odnovolov.forgetmenot.description:
ForgetMeNot is an app for memorizing information via flashcards. Simplicity, usability, speed were taken into account in the process of developing this educational program. This app provides excellent conditions for achieving high efficiency of memorization.
The features that are supported are:
 • Import/export of files.
 • Support CSV, Tab text or any other kind of Delimiter-Separated Values.
 • Intervals (Spaced repetition). You can specify your own interval scheme for each deck. Also it is possible to indicate one's own algorithm of how the answers affects the choice of the next interval.
 • Several test methods. There are 'Self testing', 'Testing with variants', 'Spell check'.
 • Pronunciation of the text via TTS. You can choose languages for questions and answers, enable autospeaking of them.
 • Hiding the text of a question to stimulate improvement of listening skills that is very useful in foreign language learning.
 • Card inversion.
 • Hints in the form of masking letters.
 • 'Motivational timer' that will make you concentrate on your studies (optionally).
 • Saving settings of deck as presets and reusing them in order to avoid routine work on settings.
 • Editing and searching cards right in the exercise.
 • 'Walking mode' that enables you do the exercise without looking at the screen.
 • 'Autoplaying mode'. In this mode questions and answers are pronounced sequentially. You can combine your own activities and repetition of teaching material.
 • Catalog of pre-made decks. The catalog contains many decks for language learning, which includes basic sets of words, thematic words and phrases, whole sentences.
 • Grouping decks into separate lists.
 • Customizing the card appearance.
 • Dark theme.
 • Backup.
What makes ForgetMeNot so efficient for memorizing:
 - No amount of advertising. You can handle a lot of cards in a short time due to the simplicity and convenience of the user interface. Nothing prevents you from studying.
 - The exercise is designed so that you must eventually grasp the answer. If your answer is wrong, the card is postponed to the end of the list until you answer correct.
 - Intervals (Spaced repetition). Spaced repetition reduces the forgetting that occurs when material is not encountered for a significant time period. It also involves actively recalling learned material, which supports learning.
 - Possibility to edit a card just in the exercise. This allows you not only to correct mistakes, but also to rebuild cards if they are difficult to remember. For example, you can add an additional association in parentheses.
 - Voice accompaniment. This is especially helpful when learning languages because it improves listening skills, helps to focus on studying and favors memorization. You can even set up a deck to perceive a question exceptionally by ear.
 - Modes that allow you to practice not only in your free time. 'Walking mode' enables you do the exercise during walking. 'Autoplaying mode' lets you listen to questions and answers when your hands and eyes are busy, but your ears are free : )
 - Focusing aids. 'Motivational timer' reminds you when you've lost your attention. Full screen mode hides the status bar, which might be an additional source of distraction.
ForgetMeNot is free and open-source software.
https://github.com/tema6120/ForgetMeNot

Soundboard mixes looping sounds from your own audio files. Play any number of
them at the same time and set each one's volume independently — rain under a

 Private by construction

accident. No account, no network calls, no telemetry, no ads, no tracking.
 Free software 
Released under the GNU General Public License v3 by 508.dev, a worker-owned
software co-op. The source is on GitHub — read it, build it, change it.

fdroid:io.github.mgdx.potable.name: Potable
fdroid:io.github.mgdx.potable.summary: Tap water in your French commune: the official test results, with no tracker.
fdroid:io.github.mgdx.potable.description:
Potable shows the results of the official sanitary control of tap water in France: the sanitary conclusion of the latest sample taken on the network that serves your commune, the detail of every analysed parameter, and how they change over time.
These results are established by the regional health agencies (ARS) and published by the French Ministry of Health through Hub'Eau. Potable shows them as published: it adds no score, no rating and no opinion of its own.
 Features 
• Find your commune offline, by name or postal code, with the department of each commune. “Near me” is optional: the location permission is only requested when you tap the button.
• The right distribution unit: when a commune is served by several, Potable lists them by district and remembers your choice; when it has none, it gives the possible causes and the ARS contact.
• The latest sample: the sanitary conclusion as published by the ARS, its date, the distributor, compliance (quality limits and quality references kept apart), and key parameters explained (hardness, also in °dH and mmol/L, nitrates, pH, free chlorine), with their quality limit or reference. A conclusion shared by several samples of the same day is shown once.
• Watched substances: PFAS (sum of 20), total pesticides, TFA, vinyl chloride, lead, arsenic, perchlorate, and chlordecone overseas. For each, the latest known measure within the history period, or “not analysed since…”; and how many pesticides were looked for and quantified.
• Search for a substance across the whole history of the unit, by a whole word of its published label.
• A box on the non-compliant samples of the last 12 months.
• “Questions about this water”: the ARS for a health question, the distributor for the water service.
• Every analysed parameter, grouped by family, with the published quality limit or reference and the relevance of pesticide metabolites according to ANSES.
• History: the curve of a parameter over 1, 3, 5 or 10 years, with the limit drawn when there is one, and the timeline of past samples, which can be filtered to non-compliances.
• Followed communes, readable offline, to export and import as a JSON file.
• Optional alerts, off by default: each new analysis, or only unfavourable conclusions, and a “Check now” button.
• Values, units and thresholds read in full words by TalkBack.
• In English and French; the official labels stay in French. Light, dark or system theme.
 What Potable does not do 
• No score, no rating, no ranking: Potable shows the conclusions of the ARS, in their own words.
• No health advice: the app does not tell you whether you can drink your water. If in doubt, the sheet of each commune names its ARS and its water distributor.
• Your own tap is not covered: samples are taken on the distribution unit, not in the private pipes of your building.
• The data are updated once a month: a result shown may be several weeks old.
 Privacy 
• A single server is contacted: hubeau.eaufrance.fr, over HTTPS. Requests contain the codes of the commune and unit you look up, and no identifier. The website of an ARS opens in your browser.
• Your position is never sent or stored: it is used once, on the phone, to find the nearest commune.
• No account and no Google service at all. No telemetry, no crash reports, no advertising. Your followed communes stay on your phone.
 Sources 
Hub'Eau “Qualité de l'eau potable” API: data from the French Ministry of Health and the ARS. Communes: Découpage administratif communal (geo.api.gouv.fr) and Code officiel géographique (INSEE), under the Licence Ouverte Etalab 2.0. Metabolites: ANSES table.
Potable is an independent application, not affiliated with Hub'Eau, the Ministry or the ARS.
Free software under the GNU GPL v3 licence.

 Shooter/Arena FPS to DOOM II, accurately replicating the game’s arsenal and greatly expanding upon
 both modes of play and the roster of playable Champions. Additionally, QC:DE includes extra content
 from Unreal Tournament.
 MAIN FEATURES
 All weapons from Quake Champions, with faithful firing times for the best transferable experience
 PVE weapon upgrades that give each weapon a whole new role
 33 champions to play, each with unique active and passive abilities
 Play Single-Player, Cooperative, Invasion, Deathmatch, CTF and more!
 QCDE Arena PVP single-player campaign in the vein of Quake 3 and Unreal Tournament 99
 High-speed movement with Doom strafe-running, Quake strafe-jumping, CPM air control, UT dodges
 and other techniques
 Monster sets to mix and match: Classic Doom, Doom 2016, Quake, Quake 2, Quake 4 and many
 more from the community
 Runs on Q-Zandronum, a fork of Zandronum with enhancements for QC:DE
 Older versions are also available for GZDoom (1.9.1 and above), Zandronum (3.0 and above)
 and Delta Touch
 Enhanced Deathmatch bots for both local and public use
 QCDEmaps: 70+ QCDE-specific maps, including both original and demakes from QC, Q3, Q4, QL,
 Doom 2016, UT and more!
 Weapon skins from every Quake game, Half-Life and Serious Sam
 Optional soundtrack by Michael Markie with original songs and covers of well-known favorites
 Optional add-ons with Unreal Tournament weapons, movement and soundtrack
 Damage numbers, speedometer, in-game champion info screens, and tons of customization with
 very sane defaults
 Lootboxes! For free!
 And more!

flathub:org.gnome.Contacts.name: Contacts
flathub:org.gnome.Contacts.description:
Contacts keeps and organize your contacts information. You can create,
 edit, delete and link together pieces of information about your contacts.
 Contacts aggregates the details from all your sources providing a
 centralized place for managing your contacts.
 Contacts will also integrate with online address books and automatically
 link contacts from different online sources.

flathub:org.texmacs.TeXmacs.name: TeXmacs
flathub:org.texmacs.TeXmacs.description:
TeXmacs is a free scientific editing platform designed
 to create beautiful technical documents using LaTeX in 
 the background. It provides a unified and user friendly 
 framework for editing structured documents with different 
 types of content: text, mathematics, graphics, interactive 
 content, slides, etc.
 This package contains:
 Gnuplot, Graphviz and Eukleides.
 It also has plugins that can extend the functionalities.

firefox-addons:863931.name: Private Bookmarks
firefox-addons:863931.description:
Private Bookmarks enables a special password-protected bookmark folder. Your private bookmarks are encrypted with your chosen password. This is not an online service, and you are in control of what data leaves your machine (if at all).
When you unlock your private bookmarks, a new 'Private Bookmarks' folder appears under 'Other Bookmarks'. You can add/remove items to it and when ready, lock it. Whenever an item is added/removed, the contents of the folder are encrypted and stored on your machine. When locked, the folder itself is removed from your browser's bookmarks collection.
By default, Private Bookmarks can only be accessed when in private browsing (to help avoid accidents), however that can be changed via the options page.
 Be aware! 
You should backup your bookmarks periodically to be safe. Also, since I am bound by Firefox regarding what it allows extensions to do, I cannot guarantee complete privacy. Mobile versions of Firefox are not supported because they do not yet allow extensions access to your bookmarks the way desktop versions do.
 A note for Firefox Sync users 
Refrain from switching between devices while your private bookmarks are unlocked. Although personally I wasn't able to reproduce, there have been some reports of Sync getting confused and it may result in a copy of the folder remaining visible on other devices. I recommend unlocking, using, and locking all on the same device. If you encounter these issues, I also advise to trigger a sync from the Firefox menu after every lock so that you're sure the deletion of the folder goes through to your other devices. Sorry about the inconvenience.
 Custom folder location and name 
You can move/rename the folder, and the next time you unlock it will appear in that location and with that name.
 Auto-locking 
There are a few cases where the extension auto locks your private bookmarks:
 If you have selected the "disable outside of private browsing" option (it is on by default) Private Bookmarks auto-locks when the last private window is closed.
 If you have selected the "auto-lock when idle" option Private Bookmarks auto-locks once the system's been idle for a user-specified amount of time.
 If you manually delete the Private Bookmarks folder.
 If you close the browser while your private bookmarks are unlocked, the next time you open it the leftover Private Bookmarks folder is deleted immediately.
 Backup 
You can export both encrypted/plain versions of your private bookmark data from within the options page. However, to import an encrypted backup file you must remember the password you used when that backup was made.
 Keyboard shortcuts 
The following shortcuts are available:
 Alt+Shift+8 opens the menu in a new tab. If you have selected the "disable outside of private browsing" option (it is on by default) the tab will open in a private window.
 Ctrl+Shift+8 adds the current page to your private bookmarks (requires unlocked bookmarks).
 Ctrl+Shift+F8 adds all tabs in the current window to your private bookmarks (requires unlocked bookmarks).
 Ctrl+Shift+L locks the folder (requires unlocked bookmarks).
 Something's not working? Got a question and/or suggestion? Post an issue.

firefox-addons:658842.name: Turbo Download Manager
firefox-addons:658842.summary: A download manager with the ability to pause and resume downloads, download remote files, and more.
firefox-addons:658842.description:
Turbo Download Manager (3rd edition) is a multi-threading download manager with a built-in tool to grab video, audio, and image sources. Similar to IDM (Internet Download Manager), and JDownloader, this extension has a built-in tool to increase the downloading speed by fetching multiple segments of the file simultaneously. This downloader is written purely in JavaScript hand there are no external dependencies.
Preview:
 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GyGSWAeKbB0 
Features:
1. Resuming broken downloads: When the downloading process is interrupted, you needn't start from the beginning again.
2. Pausing active jobs: To temporarily reduce network traffic when it is needed
3. Download acceleration: Splits files into several sections and downloads them simultaneously in an internal IndexedDB database, allowing you to use any type of connection at the maximum available speed. 
4. Enhanced audio/video files support: Has internal HTML spider module to detect media (video, audio) and image sources
5. Built-in M3U8 parser and Live Stream downloader (HLS) with AES-128 decryption support.
6. Supports custom "Referrer" header for jobs
This download manager can be used to accelerate your downloading speed or to improve download stability on low-quality networks. The extension is integrated into your browser download manager as much as possible.

apple-macos:6814236916.name: Horef Rings
apple-macos:6814236916.description:
Horef Rings puts the metrics you care about on your Apple Watch face and iPhone: three in one rectangular complication, or any metric as its own complication on any face. Start with Headroom, weather, sleep and battery, or choose from 75 metrics: weather, activity, sleep, health, calendar, device and workouts.
ANY METRIC, ANY WATCH FACE
Complications come in circular, corner, inline and rectangular sizes. Corners look like watchOS: the value in the corner and a curved scale along the bezel — today's weather low and high, battery, Headroom 0–10, goals. Pick the 12 metrics the face editor offers on iPhone in Settings → Watch complications; Left, Centre and Right show the metric in that Watch circle. All complications refresh together and show the same values.
HEADROOM
A daily 0–10 estimate of how recovered you are this morning, calculated on your devices from Health data: last night's sleep against your sleep need, overnight heart rate variability, resting heart rate, breathing rate and wrist temperature against your 28-day norm, and recent activity load. It appears as a ten-segment dial coloured by level: Rest, Easy, Steady, Push. The method is explained in the app. Headroom is a wellness estimate, not a medical measurement, and it is not Apple's Readiness score.
HISTORY AND AWARDS
Browse any week or month back to your first Health records, tap a day to see what moved its score and set your own sleep need. Earn medals for streaks and personal records, each announced by a notification.
WIDGETS FOR IPHONE
Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets in every size: Weather, Headroom, Sleep, Activity arcs and battery, a large panel and a month calendar. Tap a widget to open its page: weather for the next 24 hours (temperature, rain chance, wind) and 7 days, upcoming events by day, or the last 7 days of sleep, heart and activity. Its Open button opens Apple Weather, Apple or Google Calendar, Health or Fitness. The Apple Watch metric screen also shows the forecast and upcoming events. Horef Rings for Mac shows them on your Mac too.
BATTERY
The battery page shows time left at the current pace, the pace now and the usual pace. Optionally (Settings → Battery), each device notifies you when its own battery drains at least 1.5 times faster than usual and would last less than 6 hours, at most once between charges.
MAKE IT YOURS
Change each metric's label, number format, units, colour and style, or hide labels. Designs: Standard, Terminal or Horef Labs. Presets help you start; settings sync between iPhone and Apple Watch. The app follows your iPhone's language: English, Russian, German, French or Japanese.
FREE TO TRY, ONE-TIME PRO
Horef Rings is free to download: try every feature free for 14 days, then keep everything with a one-time Pro purchase. No subscription. Date, weekday, time, battery, steps and activity stay free. Headroom, the full catalogue, weather, calendar, health displays and iPhone widgets are part of Pro. Have a code? Redeem it on the Pro screen.
YOUR DATA, ON YOUR DEVICES
Health and Calendar access are optional. Horef Rings reads permitted records and writes only the water and caffeine you log. Headroom and its history are calculated on your devices and never sent to us. No advertising, tracking SDK or account. Apple Weather provides weather for your permitted location.
COMPATIBILITY
Apple Watch with watchOS 11 or later and an iPhone with iOS 18 or later. The three circles need a face with a large rectangular slot, such as Modular or Modular Ultra; single-metric complications work on any face with complications. Headroom needs an Apple Watch that records sleep and overnight vitals; with less than five days of history the score is marked as calibrating. Each metric depends on permissions, device capabilities and existing records. watchOS sets update timing: readings are snapshots, not continuous monitoring. Horef Rings is an information and wellness display, not a medical device. If you feel unwell, talk to a doctor.
